title: How-to walkthrough
summary: Whether the steps achieve the stated goal for a competent reader. A simulated walkthrough names the step where it failed; checks flag missing or out-of-order steps; a type check lists passages that belong in another Diátaxis type.
notes: Simulated: no sandbox ran the steps.
The walkthrough says which steps were only read, not executed.
Offer flagged passages to Restructure to type as the seed of the sibling document.

config.instructions: Take the goal from the title and the opening, and the prerequisites the guide states.

fields.name: goal
fields.label: Goal
fields.description: The task the guide promises to accomplish

config.persona: a competent practitioner with only the stated prerequisites
config.task: Follow the steps as written to reach the stated goal.
rules: the end state must equal the goal
say which steps were only read, not executed

checklist.label: No missing steps
checklist.question: Are any steps missing between the start and the goal? Name where.

checklist.label: Prerequisites stated
checklist.question: Are all prerequisites the steps rely on stated?

checklist.label: Steps in order
checklist.question: Are the steps in the order they must be done?

checklist.label: Variations handled
checklist.question: Does the guide handle the variations a working reader meets (“if you use X, do Y”)?

checklist.label: Prerequisites stated without teaching
checklist.question: Are prerequisites stated without teaching them?

checklist.label: The title names the goal
checklist.question: Does the title name the goal (“How to …”)?

config.instructions: Classify each passage by its Diátaxis role in a how-to guide.
